**Direct answer:** Sagg Eco Village is in Ganderbal district in central Kashmir, Jammu & Kashmir. Its address is Watlar Wudder, Lar, Ganderbal (PIN 191201). It lies in the Chanthan Gulabpora/Gulabpura area, about 6 km north of Ganderbal town.

**Claims and sources**
- It is located in Ganderbal, and is described as J&K's first regenerative eco-village enterprise: https://kashmirlife.net/kashmirs-sagg-eco-village-wins-silver-at-responsible-tourism-awards-2025-405409/
- The address is Watlar Wudder, Lar, Ganderbal, 191201. Ganderbal town is 6 km south of it, and the village of Wayil is about 4 km east: https://mapcarta.com/N5931593287
- Trip.com gives a matching address: "watlar wuder Lar - Chunt Waliwar Road ganderbal, Chanthan Gulabpora, J&K 191201": https://sg.trip.com/travel-guide/attraction/ganderbal/sagg-eco-village-farm-stay-and-regenerative-living-141839954/?locale=en-SG&curr=SGD
- It is in the Chanthan Gulabpura area, at the foothills of the Sindh River in the Wali War region (IANS, 2022): https://preciouskashmir.com/2022/09/21/sagg-eco-village-kashmirs-offbeat-recreational-destination/
- Its OpenStreetMap-based coordinates are about 34.27225°N, 74.76043°E: https://mapcarta.com/N5931593287. The tool did not verify the longitude against a quote, so treat it as approximate.

**Counterevidence and gaps**
- No source placed the village anywhere else. The spelling variants (Gulabpora/Gulabpura) refer to the same area.
- Sources disagree on the founding year (2012 on LinkedIn, 2013 in the IANS article). This doesn't affect the location.
- Most location details rest on single sources. The independent sources I read (Kashmir Life, IANS, Mapcarta/OSM, Trip.com) are consistent with each other. I did not check an official or government source.
